about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Who I Am
about.description: I am a Computer Architecture engineer originally from Afrin, currently based in Qamishli, Kurdistan. I studied Mechatronics at Rojava University and work as a Web Developer at Acornassociated. I have a deep passion for digital logic design, embedded systems, and full-stack web development. My work spans from designing pipelined RISC-V processors in VHDL to building modern web applications with React and Laravel.
about.mission: I believe in bridging the gap between hardware and software — creating efficient, intelligent systems that solve real-world problems.
